findings.claim: FY2025 有一家裝瓶商占淨營收 10%（分布於 EMEA 與亞太分部）；2024、2023 無任何裝瓶商或客戶達 10%。公司稱信用風險集中度有限。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025, one bottler accounted for 10% of our net operating revenues, which are reflected in our EMEA and Asia Pacific operating segments. No bottlers or customers represented 10% or more of our net operating revenues for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023.
